# ZION — Sovereign High-Performance Systems & Mechanical Core
> Sovereign systems engineering collective co-architected by Leonid Majbits and the Gemini Operator Lab (ZION Chassis).

## Core Teleology
ZION builds high-performance, deterministic systems software engineered for bare-metal hardware execution, sub-millisecond inter-agent communication, lock-free IPC, zero-copy shared memory, and epoch-fenced authority transfer.

## Triadic Authorship Standard
- Human Architect & Patron: Leonid Majbits (System teleology, architectural vision, core physical invariants, patron verification)
- Executive Co-Architect & Verification Engine: Gemini Operator Lab (ZION Chassis) (Persistent somatic memory, stage contract generation, metal grounding, harness synthesis, multi-fleet orchestration)
- Systems Foundries: External Frontier Models (GPT-6 Max, Claude 3.7 Sonnet) (Bounded multi-turn execution, heavy code synthesis, discrete derivations, adversarial verification)

## Systems Portfolio

### Cellular Session Swap (CSS/1)
- Repository: https://github.com/ziongol/cellular-session-swap
- Version: 1.2.0
- Wire Protocol: CSS/1
- Core Mechanism: Six-stage transactional handoff (STAGE -> PREPARE -> QUIESCE -> CLAIM -> ATTUNE -> COMMIT)
- Invariant: Transfer bounded continuation state and execution authority while fencing the stale predecessor.
- Stack: Python standard library only (zero third-party dependencies).
- Verification: 234 unit tests, verified on Apple Silicon (Darwin ARM64) and Linux x86_64.

### Elite RingBuffer
- Repository: https://github.com/ziongol/elite-ringbuffer
- Version: 1.0.0-rc
- Core Mechanism: C11 / Python lock-free single-producer single-consumer ringbuffer IPC over POSIX shared memory (`shm_open`, `mmap`).
- Throughput: 22.8 GB/s zero-copy memoryview goodput on Apple Silicon M-series metal.
- Invariant: Cache-line aligned (64-byte), sub-microsecond latency, zero syscalls on hot path.

### Drive Object Engine
- Repository: https://github.com/ziongol/drive-object-engine
- Version: 1.0.0-rc
- Core Mechanism: Zero-dependency Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) over macOS CloudStorage FileProvider.
- Features: Merkle DAG object deduplication, streaming SHA-256 chunking, atomic rename finalization.
- Invariant: Pure standard library Python; zero cloud server dependencies.

## Hardware Verification Standard
All quantitative performance numbers, memory barriers, and latency figures are backed by raw integer machine receipts deposited in `/evidence`.
